summary: This directory provides the infrastructure layer for database connectivity, custom SQL execution, and repository pattern abstraction, enabling consistent interaction with Kysely and MSSQL database services across the application.
responsibilities: Manage database connection lifecycle and configuration
Provide standardized repository abstractions for CRUD operations
Execute and validate custom SQL queries
relationships: The Kysely and MSSQL services manage the underlying database connections utilized by the repository layer.
The repository generator consumes schema definitions to enforce consistency when performing custom SQL operations.
Common utilities provide data transformation and validation logic required by the database services during query execution.
designDecisions: Abstracting specific SQL drivers behind a uniform service interface
Use of Effect for handling database operation results
Repository pattern for standardizing database access
Dynamic configuration of database services based on environment or prefixes
